tools.name: carrier_lookup
tools.description:
Look up an FMCSA-registered motor carrier's identity by US DOT number: legal name, DBA, operating status, FMCSA safety rating, fleet size (power units, drivers), physical address, and registration dates.

Use this first when a booking/dispatch agent needs to confirm WHO a carrier is — that a DOT num

tools.name: carrier_score
tools.description:
Get the CarrierScore risk indices for a carrier by US DOT number: two first-class, separately validated indices (0-100, HIGHER = RISKIER), each with a full component breakdown.

This is the core "is this carrier safe to book?" signal for AI booking agents. Served methodology v0.5 returns TWO indices

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: montgomery_file, save_carrier_list · Private data: montgomery_file, save_carrier_list, list_alerts, audit_entries, verify_evidence · Public sink: carrier_score, save_carrier_list · Destructive: montgomery_file, monitor_carriers, save_carrier_list.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: montgomery_file, save_carrier_list · Private data: montgomery_file, save_carrier_list, list_alerts, audit_entries, verify_evidence · Public sink: carrier_score, save_carrier_list · Destructive: montgomery_file, monitor_carriers, save_carrier_list

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
